localization_status.fallback_behavior: Use English when a localized label or description is unavailable.

topic_ids.description_en: Routine flexible bronchoscopy, airway inspection, bronchoalveolar lavage, brushing, washing, and conventional endobronchial or transbronchial sampling.
Convex-probe EBUS, EUS-B, mediastinal/hilar sampling and staging strategies.
Guidance, confirmation, and navigation technologies used to reach peripheral pulmonary lesions.
Sampling tools, localization methods, and specimen adequacy for peripheral lesions.
Malignant and benign central airway obstruction and bronchoscopic recanalization techniques.
Airway stent selection, placement, removal, stenosis, and complications.
Diagnostic and therapeutic pleural procedures.
Bronchoscopic emphysema therapies and patient selection.

topic_ids.label_en: Persistent air leak and fistula closure
topic_ids.description_en: Bronchoscopic management of persistent air leak and bronchopleural or other airway fistulas.
Cryobiopsy techniques and outcomes across ILD, peripheral, mediastinal, and endobronchial applications.
Bronchoscopic localization, control, tamponade, blockers, and procedural bleeding management.
Percutaneous tracheostomy, procedural guidance, difficult access, and complications.
Endobronchial or transbronchial focal tumor ablation technologies.
Advanced procedural topics not captured by the other primary categories.
Sedation, general anesthesia, ventilation, procedural complications, and emergency management.
Training, competency, simulation, workflow, ergonomics, quality improvement, and program outcomes.
Computer vision, image guidance, segmentation, procedural prediction, devices, and technical innovation.
Surgical or nonbronchoscopic procedures used as comparators, alternatives, or technical analogues for interventional pulmonology without being bronchoscopic interventions themselves.
topic_ids.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for surgical or nonbronchoscopic procedures when they are relevant as comparators, alternatives, or technical analogues to interventional pulmonology.
topic_ids.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude articles whose primary intervention is bronchoscopic; classify those under the corresponding bronchoscopic topic instead.
examples_en: Surgical lung-volume reduction compared with bronchoscopic lung-volume reduction
VATS localization or resection used as an adjacent procedural comparator

topic_ids.description_en: Cytology, histopathology, biomarker, and molecular-testing adequacy of specimens obtained during pulmonary or pleural procedures.
topic_ids.inclusion_boundary_en: Use when specimen sufficiency, processing, cytology or histopathology yield, biomarkers, or molecular testing is a primary focus.
topic_ids.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude studies reporting only diagnostic yield without evaluating specimen quality, processing, or downstream pathology testing.
examples_en: Adequacy of EBUS-TBNA specimens for molecular profiling
Cytology workflow and biomarker sufficiency after bronchoscopic biopsy

topic_ids.description_en: Care delivery, workflow, operations, quality, utilization, access, costs, and economic evaluation related to interventional pulmonary services.
topic_ids.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for interventional pulmonary care delivery, operations, access, utilization, quality, program outcomes, costs, or formal economic evaluation.
topic_ids.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude purely clinical efficacy or safety studies without a health-services, operational, quality, or economic objective.
examples_en: Operational outcomes after establishing an interventional pulmonology service

technology_tags.description_en: Convex-probe endobronchial ultrasound used for real-time mediastinal or hilar needle sampling.
Transesophageal ultrasound examination or sampling performed with an EBUS bronchoscope.
Radial-probe endobronchial ultrasound used to localize or characterize peripheral pulmonary lesions.
Robot-assisted bronchoscopy platforms used for navigation, localization, sampling, or therapy.
Electromagnetic navigation systems used to guide bronchoscopic access to pulmonary targets.
Cone-beam computed tomography used for intraprocedural guidance or target confirmation.
Fluoroscopic guidance enhanced by image registration, overlay, or tomosynthesis.
Computed virtual bronchoscopic pathways or airway reconstructions used for procedural planning or guidance.
Cryoprobe tissue acquisition from lung parenchyma or a peripheral pulmonary lesion through the bronchial tree.
One-way endobronchial valve placement for lung-volume reduction or management of an air leak.
Tracheal or bronchial stent placement, revision, or removal.
Rigid bronchoscopy used for airway access, ventilation, recanalization, extraction, or device delivery.
Bronchoscopic electrocautery used for tissue cutting, coagulation, or ablation.
Noncontact argon plasma coagulation used for endobronchial coagulation or ablation.
Bronchoscopic laser therapy used for coagulation, vaporization, or airway recanalization.
Bronchoscopic cryotherapy or cryorecanalization other than tissue-acquisition cryobiopsy.
Photodynamic therapy delivered for endobronchial tumor treatment.
Endobronchial brachytherapy delivered through an airway catheter.
Long-term tunneled pleural catheter placement or management.
Physician-performed pleuroscopy or medical thoracoscopy for pleural diagnosis or treatment.
Controlled radiofrequency thermal treatment of bronchial airways for severe asthma.
Sequential whole-lung lavage performed for pulmonary alveolar proteinosis or a comparable indication.
Percutaneous dilatational tracheostomy and its bronchoscopic or ultrasound guidance.
Percutaneous aspiration or drainage of pleural fluid with a needle or temporary catheter.
technology_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for needle or temporary-catheter aspiration of pleural fluid.
technology_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude an indwelling drain left for ongoing evacuation; use chest-tube or indwelling-pleural-catheter as appropriate.

technology_tags.description_en: Tube thoracostomy or small-bore pleural catheter drainage left in place for ongoing evacuation.
technology_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for tube thoracostomy or small-bore pleural drainage maintained after insertion.
technology_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude single-session pleural aspiration and tunneled long-term catheters.

technology_tags.description_en: Chemical or mechanical pleural symphysis intended to prevent recurrent pleural fluid or air.
technology_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for chemical or mechanical attempts to create pleural symphysis.
technology_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude drainage alone and indwelling pleural catheter placement without pleurodesis.

technology_tags.description_en: Bronchoalveolar lavage performed through a bronchoscope for diagnostic sampling or therapeutic clearance.
technology_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use when bronchoalveolar lavage is a named diagnostic sampling or therapeutic technique.
technology_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude generic bronchoscopy, bronchial washing, and whole-lung lavage.

technology_tags.description_en: Non-ultrasound-guided transbronchial needle aspiration using anatomic landmarks.
technology_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for landmark-guided TBNA performed without real-time convex EBUS guidance.

technology_tags.description_en: Immediate on-site cytologic assessment of procedural specimens to evaluate adequacy or guide further sampling.
technology_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use when immediate cytology review is used to assess specimen adequacy or guide additional sampling.
technology_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude routine final cytopathology and biopsy-device descriptions without on-site assessment.

technology_tags.description_en: Endobronchial coil implantation for bronchoscopic lung-volume reduction.
technology_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for implanted bronchoscopic coils intended for lung-volume reduction.
technology_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude endobronchial valves, vapor ablation, and surgical lung-volume reduction.

technology_tags.description_en: Balloon dilation of a tracheal or bronchial narrowing.
technology_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for balloon dilation of tracheal or bronchial stenosis.
technology_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude airway stenting unless a stent is separately placed or studied.

technology_tags.description_en: Cryoprobe tissue acquisition from mediastinal or hilar lymph nodes or masses, typically through an EBUS-guided tract.
technology_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for cryobiopsy of a mediastinal or hilar node or mass through an airway or EBUS-created tract.
technology_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude transbronchial lung or peripheral-lesion cryobiopsy.
examples_en: Cryobiopsy of a mediastinal lymph node

technology_tags.description_en: Bronchoscopic extraction of an aspirated or retained airway foreign body.
technology_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for bronchoscopic extraction of an aspirated or retained airway object.
technology_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude the disease or presentation alone when no removal procedure is described.

technology_tags.description_en: Endovascular embolization of bronchial or systemic arteries to control hemoptysis.
technology_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for endovascular bronchial or systemic arterial embolization undertaken for hemoptysis.
technology_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude bronchoscopic topical or ablative hemostasis.
examples_en: Bronchial artery embolization for massive hemoptysis

technology_tags.description_en: Narrow-band optical imaging used during bronchoscopy to enhance mucosal and vascular patterns.
technology_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use when narrow-band imaging is employed to examine airway mucosa or vasculature.
technology_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude white-light bronchoscopy, autofluorescence imaging, and confocal endomicroscopy.

technology_tags.description_en: Autofluorescence imaging used during bronchoscopy to identify abnormal airway mucosa.
technology_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use when autofluorescence imaging is employed to detect or characterize airway mucosal abnormalities.
technology_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude narrow-band imaging and white-light bronchoscopy alone.

technology_tags.description_en: Probe-based or needle-based confocal laser endomicroscopy used for microscopic in-vivo imaging.
technology_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for probe-based or needle-based confocal microscopic imaging during pulmonary or pleural procedures.
technology_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude optical coherence tomography and other optical imaging without confocal microscopy.
examples_en: Probe-based CLE of a peripheral lesion

technology_tags.description_en: Topically delivered airway hemostatic material or drug used to control endobronchial bleeding.
technology_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for a named topical material or medication applied endobronchially to control bleeding.
technology_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude laser, electrocautery, APC, balloon tamponade, and systemic hemostatic therapy.

technology_tags.description_en: Thermal tumor ablation delivered through a bronchoscopic or transbronchial access path.
technology_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for microwave, radiofrequency, or comparable thermal ablation delivered through a bronchoscopic access path.
technology_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude bronchial thermoplasty, nonthermal pulsed-field ablation, and percutaneous or surgical ablation.

technology_tags.description_en: Video-assisted thoracic surgery used as an adjacent surgical procedure, comparator, or procedural analogue.
technology_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for video-assisted thoracic surgery when represented as an adjacent procedure, comparator, or analogue.
technology_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude medical thoracoscopy and bronchoscopic procedures.

clinical_purposes.description_en: Establishing, confirming, or refining a diagnosis.
Delivering or evaluating a therapeutic intervention.
Relieving symptoms or improving comfort without curative intent.
Monitoring for recurrence, progression, complications, or interval change.
Locating or marking a target to guide another diagnostic or therapeutic procedure.
Teaching, simulation, competency assessment, or procedural education.
Preventing, detecting, or managing procedural adverse events.
Addressing multiple clinical purposes or providing a broad procedural overview.
The clinical purpose cannot be determined from the available metadata.
Evaluating costs, value, utilization, access, care pathways, or service delivery.
clinical_purposes.inclusion_boundary_en: Use when costs, value, utilization, access, care pathways, or service delivery are primary objectives.
clinical_purposes.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude clinical outcome studies that do not evaluate a health-services or economic objective.

clinical_purposes.description_en: Evaluating whether a specimen is sufficient for cytology, histology, biomarker, or molecular testing.
clinical_purposes.inclusion_boundary_en: Use when adequacy for diagnosis, histology, cytology, biomarkers, or molecular testing is a primary objective.
clinical_purposes.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude diagnostic-yield reporting that does not assess specimen sufficiency or processing.

clinical_purposes.description_en: Evaluating procedural workflow, service operations, quality improvement, or program performance.
clinical_purposes.inclusion_boundary_en: Use when workflow, operational performance, quality improvement, or program delivery is a primary objective.
clinical_purposes.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude training-only work and general overviews without a defined operational or quality aim.
examples_en: Quality metrics for an interventional pulmonology program

disease_tags.description_en: Primary lung carcinoma and its intrathoracic evaluation or treatment.
Pulmonary emphysema, including patients evaluated for lung-volume reduction.
Diffuse parenchymal or interstitial lung disease.
Pulmonary or airway disease driven primarily by immune or inflammatory processes.
Lung-transplant recipients, graft airways, or transplant-related complications.
Fixed nonmalignant tracheal or bronchial narrowing.
Non-mesothelioma pleural effusion, pneumothorax, pleuritis, or other pleural disorder.
Lymphoid, leukemic, plasma-cell, or other hematologic malignancy involving thoracic structures.
disease_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for lymphoma, leukemia, plasma-cell, or other hematologic malignancy involving thoracic structures.
disease_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude primary lung carcinoma and extrathoracic solid-tumor metastases.

disease_tags.description_en: Thoracic, airway, lung, or pleural involvement by a primary malignancy arising outside the thorax.
disease_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use when a solid malignancy arising outside the thorax metastasizes to lung, airway, lymph node, or pleura.
disease_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude primary lung cancer and hematologic malignancy.

disease_tags.description_en: Dynamic expiratory collapse caused by airway-wall weakness or excessive invagination of the posterior membrane.
disease_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for dynamic expiratory central-airway collapse due to malacia or excessive posterior-membrane invagination.
disease_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude fixed benign airway stenosis and transient collapse without a TBM or EDAC diagnosis.

disease_tags.description_en: Asthma, including severe asthma evaluated for bronchial thermoplasty.
disease_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for studies whose clinical population or disease focus is asthma.
disease_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude other obstructive airway diseases without asthma.
examples_en: Severe asthma treated with bronchial thermoplasty

disease_tags.description_en: Aspiration or retention of a foreign object in the tracheobronchial tree.
disease_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for aspiration or retention of a foreign object in the airway.
disease_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Do not use solely because a removal device is discussed without foreign-body disease or presentation.

disease_tags.description_en: Coughing or expectoration of blood arising from the lower respiratory tract.
disease_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use when lower-respiratory bleeding or hemoptysis is a clinical problem or diagnosis.
disease_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Do not use solely for procedural bleeding prophylaxis or a hemostatic technology without hemoptysis.

disease_tags.description_en: Chronic abnormal bronchial dilation and its complications.
disease_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for studies whose clinical population or disease focus is bronchiectasis.
disease_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude isolated airway dilation not diagnosed as bronchiectasis.

disease_tags.description_en: Alveolar accumulation of surfactant material characteristic of pulmonary alveolar proteinosis.
disease_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for autoimmune, hereditary, secondary, or other pulmonary alveolar proteinosis.

disease_tags.description_en: Localized or systemic amyloid deposition affecting the tracheobronchial tree.
disease_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use when amyloid deposition affects the trachea or bronchi.

disease_tags.description_en: A structural or developmental airway abnormality present from birth.
disease_tags.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for congenital structural or developmental abnormalities of the trachea or bronchi.
disease_tags.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude acquired stenosis, malacia without congenital attribution, and congenital parenchymal disease without airway involvement.

study_design.description_en: A prospective experiment assigning participants to interventions by random allocation.
An observational cohort defined and followed forward from enrollment.
An observational cohort assembled from prior records or events and analyzed by exposure or intervention.
A study estimating test performance against a reference standard.
A structured evidence synthesis using an explicit search and selection method without a primary pooled meta-analysis designation.
A quantitative synthesis combining results from multiple studies.
Evidence-informed recommendations for clinical practice.
Expert consensus, statement, or position document not classified as a formal guideline.
A descriptive report of multiple patients without a comparison group.
A descriptive report of one patient or clinical episode.
A report primarily describing a procedural technique, device use, or technical modification in clinical practice.
An opinion, commentary, or editorial without original study methods.
A narrative or nonsystematic synthesis of prior literature.
The study design cannot be determined from the available metadata.
A quantitative survey or cross-sectional measurement of a defined population at one period.
study_design.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for quantitative survey or cross-sectional data collected at one period without longitudinal follow-up.
study_design.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude interview-based thematic research and cohorts defined by follow-up over time.

study_design.description_en: A formal comparison of costs, consequences, or value across care strategies.
study_design.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for cost-effectiveness, cost-utility, cost-benefit, budget-impact, or decision-analytic economic comparisons.
study_design.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude general health-services observations that report resource use without a formal economic evaluation.

study_design.description_en: An in-vivo experiment conducted in nonhuman animals before or outside clinical evaluation.
study_design.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for in-vivo experiments in nonhuman animals.
study_design.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude isolated tissue, ex-vivo organs, phantoms, and other bench or in-vitro testing.

study_design.description_en: A laboratory, phantom, cadaveric, ex-vivo, or in-vitro technical experiment without living human participants.
study_design.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for laboratory, phantom, cadaveric, ex-vivo, or in-vitro experiments without living human participants.
study_design.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude in-vivo animal studies and clinical technical notes describing patient care.

study_design.description_en: Research using interviews, focus groups, observation, or qualitative text analysis to develop themes or explanations.
study_design.inclusion_boundary_en: Use for research based primarily on interviews, focus groups, observation, or qualitative coding and thematic analysis.
study_design.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude structured quantitative questionnaires analyzed as cross-sectional surveys.

study_design.description_en: An observational comparison selecting participants by outcome or case status and examining prior exposures or characteristics.
study_design.inclusion_boundary_en: Use when cases and controls are selected by outcome or case status and prior exposures or characteristics are compared.
study_design.exclusion_boundary_en: Exclude retrospective cohorts selected by exposure or intervention and followed to outcomes.
examples_en: Cases with a complication compared with matched controls

publication_status.description_en: A complete journal article rather than an abstract-only record.
An abstract or proceedings record without a complete journal article.
A retraction notice or retracted-publication record.
A published study or trial protocol without final results.
An interactive, image-based, quiz-style, or educational clinical case publication.
The publication status cannot be determined from the available metadata.

optional_tag_statuses.description_en: One or more controlled terms have been assigned.
No controlled term applies after the field has been assessed.
Available evidence is insufficient to determine whether a controlled term applies.
A compatibility-only state for an empty v1 field whose completion meaning was not recorded.
